model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different types of logical relationships. The chart contains six slices, each representing a distinct category. The slices are labeled “Existential Quantifiers” (pink, 15.12%), “Limiter” (orange, 27.91%), “Negation” (yellow, 27.91%), “Universal Quantifiers” (light blue, 29.07%), “Comparative Relationships” (light purple, 36.26%), and “Approximate Quantities” (dark purple, 45.03%). A legend is present and identifies each category with its corresponding color. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The segments appear ordered visually, progressing clockwise from the smallest percentage to the largest. A final slice, labeled "Disjunctive &Conjunctive" (gray, 50.49%) is offset from the rest of the chart and includes "Approximate Number Generation" and "Disjunctive" labels.
